P01.rationale: A large video-still portrait of a person occupies roughly half the left column, serving as a dominant human anchor, though it reads as a video screenshot rather than a composed portrait.

P05.rationale: The client (Niklas Klein) is shown in a sizable image that fills most of the left column, clearly named below, though it is a video frame rather than a formal portrait.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present beyond a single inline quote attribution.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears on the right column, but it is modest in scale and the only decorative typographic element present.

P11.rationale: Three large numerical stats (16+ Std., 45, 3 Monate) are displayed as bold typographic callouts but without charts, before/after bars, or cost-math visualisations.

P12.rationale: The left column is well-filled with image, body text, and structured sections, but the right column has significant empty space below the quote, leaving the sheet feeling only moderately dense.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white paper texture is used as the background, providing mild atmosphere but not a strong or intentional textural treatment.

P14.rationale: The video-still image has overlaid text baked into the photo itself ('+16 Stunden Ar… pro Kunde') which is legible, but no editorial scrim is applied over the image by the designer.

P16.rationale: No phone, laptop, book, or product mockup is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The image appears to be a real client video screenshot with branded overlay text, giving it some specificity, though the setting (generic office exterior) has a slightly stock feel.

N08.rationale: The lower half of the right column is largely empty after the quote and attribution, creating a noticeable dead-whitespace region.

N10.rationale: The video-still has text overlaid directly on the image without a designer-applied scrim, though the original video graphic provides enough contrast to remain readable.
